crossRefs.note: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here…
Out of the part of the children of Judah was the inheritance of the children of Simeon; for the portion of the children…
“Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

people.name: Simeon
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.

translations.web: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
translations.bsb: The second lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Simeon: Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah
translations.kjv: And the second lot came forth to Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah.
translations.asv: And the second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families: and their inheritance was in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Judah.
